title: Supertech projects: 'Will exit if homebuyers don't want our involvement'
description:
State-owned NBCC, tasked with completing 16 stalled housing projects of debt-ridden realty firm Supertech, on Monday told the Supreme Court that it would like to exit if the homebuyers do not want its involvement.
Earlier, the apex court on February 5 upheld a National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (NCLAT) order asking the National Buildings Construction Corporation (NBCC) to complete 16 housing projects, out of a total 30, of Supertech Limited.
The matter came up for hearing on Monday before a bench comprising Chief Justice Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana, which reserved its order.
"I (NBCC) do not want to be an unwanted child in the entire proceedings," Attorney General R Venkataramani, appearing for the NBCC, told the bench.
"The eight per cent rate of the project cost is a government-fixed rate and if nobody wants NBCC, then we would like to exit," Venkataramani said.
